raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

With a nonzero prefill/decode interval, a completed cached or short prefill starts another full decode-only hold. At interval 64, an already-waiting request can therefore miss 64 scheduler admission opportunities even though no unfinished prompt chunk remains.

Add an opt-in policy to protect decoding between unfinished prompt chunks while allowing admission immediately after a completed prefill. The default remains unchanged.

## Modifications

`SGLANG_PDI_CHUNKED_ONLY=1` arms the interval only when `batch.chunked_req` is present; completing a prefill clears any remaining hold. Data-parallel attention always retains the synchronized fixed cadence, using the existing global extend flag. This adds no rank-local timers or collectives.

Tests cover the default policy, completed/unfinished prefills, clearing a previous hold, decode/empty batches, and matching DP cadence on ranks with different local work. Developed with AI assistance.

## Accuracy Tests

`pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_prefill_decode_interval.py`: **10 passed, 3 subtests passed**, importing the current upstream scheduler. All pre-commit hooks pass on the three changed files.

This changes admission timing, with no model-forward or kernel changes. A prior downstream serving validation passed its 10-case quality gate and concurrent long-prompt recall checks; that is supplementary evidence, not a full current-main serving qualification.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Prior controlled measurement of this same policy on a v0.6.0-based serving build, two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q GPUs at 300 W, concurrency 2, interval 64: 576 replay requests across four sequential arms. Median cached TTFT changed from 726 to 380 ms (-47.7%; session-bootstrap 95% interval -58.1% to -22.1%). Completion median changed from 989 to 1,054 ms (inconclusive); p90 TTFT was essentially unchanged at 976 versus 987 ms. Long-prefill overlap decode remained approximately 114 tokens/s. This is workload-specific evidence, not a general throughput claim or a measurement of current upstream main.

Paired CUPTI/Python traces on that build identified the mechanism: the fixed policy made zero prefill-admission calls in 25 observed scheduler decisions while GPUs continued decoding; chunk-only protection admitted a mixed batch. This motivated the narrow scheduler change.

The added CPU tests provide a deterministic reproduction of the admission behavior with synthetic batches. Request payloads and raw deployment traces are not part of this contribution.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -655,6 +655,10 @@ class Envs:
     # PP: skip output send/recv when the entire batch consists of non-final chunked prefill requests,
     # since process_batch_result_prefill discards next_token_ids for those anyway.
     SGLANG_PP_SKIP_PURE_CHUNKED_OUTPUT_COMM = EnvBool(False)
+    # Restrict prefill-decode interval protection to unfinished prompt chunks.
+    # DP attention retains its synchronized fixed cadence. Default preserves
+    # protection after every prefill batch.
+    SGLANG_PDI_CHUNKED_ONLY = EnvBool(False)
     # Run PP tensor communication on a dedicated stream so asynchronous sends
     # do not fence the next forward through the scheduler stream.
     SGLANG_PP_COMM_OVERLAP = EnvBool(False)

@@ -1313,6 +1313,7 @@ def init_running_status(self):
     def init_chunked_prefill(self):
         self.chunked_prefill_size = get_schedule().chunked_prefill_size
         self.prefill_decode_interval = get_schedule().prefill_decode_interval or 0
+        self.pdi_chunked_only = envs.SGLANG_PDI_CHUNKED_ONLY.get()
         self._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = 0
         uses_transformers_backend = (
             get_resolved_model_impl(self.model_config) == ModelImpl.TRANSFORMERS
@@ -1376,7 +1377,17 @@ def _arm_prefill_decode_interval(self, batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch]) -> None:
             else batch.forward_mode.is_extend()
         )
         if is_extend:
-            self._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = self.prefill_decode_interval
+            # Protect decoding between unfinished prompt chunks. Completed
+            # prefills can admit the next request immediately in this mode.
+            # DP ranks retain the globally synchronized fixed cadence.
+            protect_decode = (
+                not self.pdi_chunked_only
+                or self.require_mlp_sync
+                or batch.chunked_req is not None
+            )
+            self._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = (
+                self.prefill_decode_interval if protect_decode else 0
+            )
 
     def init_metrics_reporter(self) -> None:
         # Override point for deployments that need a specialized reporter.

@@ -13,18 +13,22 @@
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
 
-def _make_scheduler(*, interval: int, require_mlp_sync: bool) -> Scheduler:
+def _make_scheduler(
+    *, interval: int, require_mlp_sync: bool, chunked_only: bool = False
+) -> Scheduler:
     scheduler = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
     scheduler.prefill_decode_interval = interval
+    scheduler.pdi_chunked_only = chunked_only
     scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = 0
     scheduler.require_mlp_sync = require_mlp_sync
     return scheduler
 
 
-def _make_batch(*, local_extend: bool, global_extend: bool):
+def _make_batch(*, local_extend: bool, global_extend: bool, chunked_req=None):
     return SimpleNamespace(
         forward_mode=SimpleNamespace(is_extend=lambda: local_extend),
         is_extend_in_batch=global_extend,
+        chunked_req=chunked_req,
     )
 
 
@@ -70,6 +74,75 @@ def test_decode_batch_does_not_rearm_interval(self):
 
         self.assertEqual(scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining, 1)
 
+    def test_completed_prefill_does_not_delay_next_admission(self):
+        scheduler = _make_scheduler(
+            interval=64, require_mlp_sync=False, chunked_only=True
+        )
+        scheduler._arm_prefill_decode_interval(
+            _make_batch(local_extend=True, global_extend=False)
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(scheduler._should_defer_prefill())
+
+    def test_unfinished_prompt_keeps_decode_protection(self):
+        scheduler = _make_scheduler(
+            interval=2, require_mlp_sync=False, chunked_only=True
+        )
+        scheduler._arm_prefill_decode_interval(
+            _make_batch(local_extend=True, global_extend=False, chunked_req=object())
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(scheduler._should_defer_prefill())
+        self.assertTrue(scheduler._should_defer_prefill())
+        self.assertFalse(scheduler._should_defer_prefill())
+
+    def test_finishing_chunk_clears_remaining_hold(self):
+        scheduler = _make_scheduler(
+            interval=64, require_mlp_sync=False, chunked_only=True
+        )
+        scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = 17
+        scheduler._arm_prefill_decode_interval(
+            _make_batch(local_extend=True, global_extend=False)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining, 0)
+
+    def test_dp_ranks_keep_matching_cadence(self):
+        for local_extend, chunked_req in (
+            (True, object()),
+            (True, None),
+            (False, None),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(
+                local_extend=local_extend, unfinished=chunked_req is not None
+            ):
+                scheduler = _make_scheduler(
+                    interval=2, require_mlp_sync=True, chunked_only=True
+                )
+                scheduler._arm_prefill_decode_interval(
+                    _make_batch(
+                        local_extend=local_extend,
+                        global_extend=True,
+                        chunked_req=chunked_req,
+                    )
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining, 2)
+
+    def test_decode_does_not_clear_chunk_protection(self):
+        scheduler = _make_scheduler(
+            interval=2, require_mlp_sync=False, chunked_only=True
+        )
+        scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = 1
+        scheduler._arm_prefill_decode_interval(
+            _make_batch(local_extend=False, global_extend=False)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining, 1)
+
+    def test_none_batch_does_not_change_protection(self):
+        scheduler = _make_scheduler(
+            interval=2, require_mlp_sync=False, chunked_only=True
+        )
+        scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = 1
+        scheduler._arm_prefill_decode_interval(None)
+        self.assertEqual(scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining, 1)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
